title: npm, pnpm and Yarn
description: Conventions for npm, pnpm and Yarn.

rules.title: One package manager
rules.text: Use the package manager the repository already uses, declare it in the packageManager field and never mix lockfiles.

rules.title: Frozen installs in CI
rules.text: Install in CI with the frozen lockfile command (npm ci, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, yarn install --immutable).

rules.title: Workspace protocol
rules.text: Reference sibling packages with the workspace protocol and keep shared dependency versions aligned.

rules.title: Be wary of install scripts
rules.text: Review packages that run install scripts before allowing them, and prefer pinned, well-maintained dependencies.

rules.title: Declare engines
rules.text: Declare supported Node versions in engines and a version file such as .nvmrc.
